verdict.rationale: OpenRouter provides explicit routing rules for switching models by priority/fallback (model array with automatic fallback on error, rate-limit, or moderation refusal), provider selection customization, load balancing across providers, and a 'meta' auto-router that routes prompts to appropriately capable models by cost/complexity, confirmed by both docs and hands-on community reports. Some caveats exist around reliability/support and edge cases (e.g., ZDR routing quirks, occasional debugging difficulty) but the core capability is well-documented and corroborated.
